claims.summary:
I haven't written the schedule because the batch doesn't fit the allowances that are actually free right now.

From the ledger at cutoff 9: the committed C unit and the active holds leave A 3/6/9, B 3/3/5, C 3/3/6 and D 3/5/6 free at starts 10/11/12. The six calls need 14 units and every route uses exactly one of A or B, so A and B must both be used up completely. Only one route split works (request-3 and request-5 on B, the rest on A). In that split, D forces request-4 to start at 12, and request-1 and request-2 then both have to run via AC by start 11. That needs 4 C units, but only 3 are free until the C hold expires at 12.

If the customer can approve one more C unit (or one more A or B unit), or release the C hold early, I can finish the runner and produce the schedule. I have not modified any files.
